answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the ocean until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the thread of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
